body:
Spotted this just now, but with a different replication path... If you use: https://instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories/?selectedKind=RefinementList\&selectedStory=with%20show%20more\&full=0\&addons=1\&stories=1\&panelRight=0\&addonPanel=storybook%2Factions%2Factions-panel

* Observe the filter limit is 3
* Click show more
* enter enough chars into the search box to reduce filters, e.g. `samsungasd`

You will see `Show less` remains even though only 3 filters are present

This is my +1 ... hopefully someone can fix this soon :)
